digest.component_or_area: LLM capability inference and model settings configuration
propositions: Capability decisions for native structured output and prompt caching are currently made by string-matching provider names, causing silent failures for Bedrock-hosted Claude models whose capability flags diverge from the direct Anthropic API

The fix must replace provider name string matching with reads from ModelProfile, using field-presence detection for Bedrock (bedrock_supports_prompt_caching) rather than isinstance checks to avoid requiring boto3 at import time

A new leaf module src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py must export ModelCapabilities dataclass, capabilities_for() accepting model objects or lazy model strings, _PROFILE_RESOLVERS registry, _REBAR_OVERRIDES tuple applying Claude-specific overrides, and cache_settings_for() function

The rebar override table must enforce native_structured_output=False for Claude on both direct Anthropic and Bedrock hosts, preventing silent behavior change from PromptedOutput to NativeOutput despite profiles reporting True
All provider-name string matching patterns (startswith checks, _NATIVE_OUTPUT_PROVIDERS frozenset, _anthropic_cache_settings function) must be eliminated and replaced by capability-based dispatch
The change must remain behavior-preserving for OpenAI and Google providers using lazy model strings, reading their profiles via _PROFILE_RESOLVERS without importing their optional SDKs
